divisions.name: Penyakit Tropik dan Infeksi
divisions.description: Sepsis & Syok Septik, Demam/FUO, Dengue/DSS, Demam Tifoid, Leptospirosis, Tetanus, Zoonosis Bakterial, Malaria, Amebiasis, HIV & IO (Toksoplasma, Kriptokokus, PCP, CMV, IMS), Diare Infeksi, Helmintiasis, Mikosis Invasif, Infeksi Nosokomial/AMR & Vaksinasi Dewasa (SK KKI 181/2024 & PAPDI Edisi VII)

divisions.name: Kardiologi dan Kedokteran Vaskular
divisions.description: Kurikulum Opsi B — 5 Sub-Klaster (16 Modul): T1 Koroner (STEMI, NSTE-ACS, CCS & Dislipidemia), T2 Gagal Jantung & Syok (ADHF, Syok Kardiogenik, HF Kronik), T3 Aritmia (VT/VF & SVT, AF RVR, Bradiaritmia/AV Block), T4 Katup, Endokardium & Perikardium (Penyakit Katup & Demam Reumatik, Endokarditis Infektif & Mioperikarditis/Kardio-Onkologi, Tamponade Jantung), T5 Hipertensi & Vaskular (Hipertensi Esensial, Krisis Hipertensi, Diseksi Aorta & PAD/ALI, Emboli Paru Akut) — PAPDI Edisi VII & ESC/AHA Guidelines

divisions.name: Pulmonologi dan Medik Kritis
divisions.description: Fisiologi & spirometri, infeksi napas (CAP/HAP/VAP, TB-SO/TB-RO, mikosis & abses paru), penyakit saluran napas (asma, PPOK, bronkiektasis), pleura & mediastinum, ILD, emboli paru & hipertensi pulmonal, onkologi toraks, serta gagal napas akut, ARDS, ventilasi mekanik & OSA.

divisions.name: Gastroenterohepatologi
divisions.description: Kurikulum 5 Sub-Klaster (20 Modul): Esofagus, GERD & Akalasia, Dispepsia, H. pylori & Ulkus Peptikum, Perdarahan SCBA Non-Variseal & Variseal (Baveno VII), Perdarahan SCBB, Diare Kronik/Malabsorpsi, IBD (UC vs Crohn), IBS (Rome IV), Polip & KKR, Ikterus/R-Value & ALF, Hepatitis B & C Kronik, MASLD/Alkoholik/DILI/Autoimun, Sirosis, Asites/SBP, Ensefalopati Hepatikum, KSH (BCLC), Kolelitiasis/Koledokolitiasis/Polip Empedu, Kolesistitis Akut (TG18), Kolangitis Akut (TG18), Pankreatitis Akut (Revised Atlanta & WATERFALL), serta Pankreatitis Kronik, IPMN & Kanker Pankreas (SK KKI 181/2024 & PAPDI Edisi VII)

divisions.name: Ginjal dan Hipertensi
divisions.description: Urinalisis, Cairan-Elektrolit-Asam Basa, AKI & AIN, Glomerulopati & Nefritis Lupus, PGK & TPG, BSK/ISK, Hipertensi & Sindrom Multiorgan (SK KKI 181/2024 & PAPDI Edisi VII)

divisions.name: Endokrinologi Metabolik dan Diabetes
divisions.description: Kurikulum 5 Sub-Klaster (14 Modul): Klasifikasi & Diagnosis DM (PERKENI/ADA), OAD & Injeksi Non-Insulin Berbasis Komorbid Organ, Terapi Insulin & Hiperglikemia Rawat Inap, KAD & HHS, Hipoglikemia & Insulinoma, Komplikasi Mikrovaskular & Kaki Diabetik (PEDIS/Wagner), Tirotoksikosis/Graves/Tiroiditis, Hipotiroid & Koma Miksedema, Krisis Tiroid (Burch-Wartofsky), Nodul Tiroid (ACR TI-RADS/Bethesda), Cushing & Krisis Adrenal, Feokromositoma & Conn, Adenoma Hipofisis & Diabetes Insipidus, Dislipidemia Primer, Hiperparatiroidisme & Osteoporosis (SK KKI 181/2024 & PAPDI Edisi VII)

divisions.name: Hematologi Onkologi Medik
divisions.description: Kurikulum 5 Sub-Klaster (14 Modul): Pendekatan Anemia, ADB & ACD, Megaloblastik B12/Folat, Talasemia & Hemoglobinopati, Anemia Aplastik (Camitta) & MDS, AIHA Hangat/Dingin (DAT), Hemolisis Non-Imun (G6PD, PNH, MAHA), Leukemia Akut (AML, APL, ALL & Leukostasis), MPN (CML BCR::ABL1, PV, ET, PMF), Limfoma Hodgkin/NHL & CLL, Mieloma Multipel (SLiM-CRAB) & Waldenstrom, ITP/TTP (PLASMIC)/HUS/HIT, DIC (ISTH)/Hemofilia/vWD, DVT/APS & Kedokteran Transfusi (TRALI/TACO), serta Onkologi Sistemik & Kegawatdaruratan (Neutropenia Febril MASCC, TLS Cairo-Bishop, MSCC) (SK KKI 181/2024 & PAPDI Edisi VII)

divisions.name: Reumatologi
divisions.description: Kurikulum 4 Sub-Klaster (12 Modul): Pendekatan Artritis, Analisis Cairan Sendi & Pola ANA IIF, Artritis Reumatoid (ACR/EULAR 2010, DAS28 & DMARD), Spondiloartritis Aksial (AS Bamboo Spine, PsA & Artritis Reaktif), Lupus Eritematosus Sistemik (ACR/EULAR 2019 & SLEDAI), Tata Laksana SLE, Nefritis Lupus, NPSLE, Kehamilan & APS, Sklerosis Sistemik (Kapilaroskopi & Krisis Renal Captopril), Sindrom Sjogren & MCTD, Miopati Inflamatorik (PM/DM & Anti-Jo1), Artritis Gout & Pseudogout/CPPD (Polarisasi Kristal), Artritis Septik & Osteomielitis, Osteoartritis (Kellgren-Lawrence), Reumatik Ekstraartikular, Fibromialgia & GIOP, serta Vaskulitis Sistemik (Takayasu, GCA, PAN, ANCA GPA/MPA/EGPA, IgAV, Behcet & IgG4-RD) (SK KKI 181/2024 & PAPDI Edisi VII)

divisions.name: Alergi Imunologi Klinik
divisions.description: Hipersensitivitas Gell & Coombs (Tipe I–IVd), Syok Anafilaksis & Epinefrin IM, Urtikaria Kronik (CSU) & Angioedema (HAE/ACEi), Rinitis Alergi (ARIA) & Alergi Makanan, SCARs (SJS/TEN, DRESS, AGEP), Desensitisasi Obat & AERD, Imunodefisiensi Primer Dewasa (CVID/IgA) & Vaksinasi Populasi Khusus

plannedModules.title: Anafilaksis & Reaksi Hipersensitivitas Akut Mengancam Jiwa
Alergi Obat Berat: SJS/TEN, DRESS & AGEP

divisions.name: Geriatri
divisions.description: P3G/CGA (Barthel/MNA/GDS), Polifarmasi (AGS Beers & STOPP/START), Delirium Akut (CAM) vs Demensia, Frailty & Sarkopenia (AWGS), Instabilitas/Jatuh, Imobilisasi, Ulkus Dekubitus & Inkontinensia

plannedModules.title: Sindrom Delirium Akut vs Demensia pada Pasien Geriatri
Imobilisasi, Ulkus Dekubitus, Inkontinensia & Risiko Jatuh

divisions.name: Psikosomatik dan Paliatif Medik
divisions.description: Aksis HPA, Ketidakseimbangan Otonom-Vegetatif & HRV, Gangguan Somatoform, Fibromialgia (ACR) & ME/CFS, Sindrom Hiperventilasi & IBS, GAD, Gangguan Panik, PTSD & Insomnia, Depresi Komorbid Kronik & Psikofarmaka Aman Organ, Nyeri Kanker (WHO Ladder & Konversi Opioid), Gejala Paliatif & Komunikasi SPIKES

plannedModules.title: Manajemen Nyeri Kanker (WHO Analgesic Ladder & Titrasi Opioid)
Gangguan Depresi & Ansietas Komorbid Penyakit Medis Kronik
Ketidakseimbangan Vegetatif, Sindrom Lelah Kronik & Fibromialgia
Perawatan Paliatif Akhir Hayat (End-of-Life Care) & Komunikasi Klinis
